tags.crowded_buy: Crowded buy: far more 13F managers added than cut this quarter
tags.new_money: New money: among the most new positions opened this quarter
tags.big_inflow: Big inflow: among the largest estimated net dollar additions this quarter
tags.crowded_exit: Crowded exit: far more managers cut than added
tags.big_outflow: Big outflow: among the largest estimated net dollar reductions
tags.officials_buying: Officials buying: a public official reported a purchase in the last 90 days
tags.officials_cluster: Officials cluster: two or more officials reported purchases within a year
tags.officials_selling: Officials selling: more reported sales than purchases in the last 90 days
tags.near_high: Near 52-week high: within 3% of the highest close of the last year
tags.momentum: Momentum: up 20% or more over three months
tags.drawdown: Drawdown: down 20% or more over three months
tags.buying_the_dip: Buying the dip: managers crowding in while the price fell 10%+ over three months
tags.insider_buying: Insider buying: officers or directors bought $100K+ of stock in the open market in the last 90 days (Form 4)
tags.insider_cluster: Insider cluster: three or more insiders bought within 30 days (Form 4)
tags.insider_selling: Insider selling: the CEO or CFO sold $1M+ in 90 days with no insider purchases (Form 4)
tags.revenue_surge: Revenue surge: latest quarter revenue up 25%+ year over year (Filing Flows)
tags.profitable_growth: Profitable growth: revenue up 15%+ with an operating margin of 15%+ (Filing Flows)
